expectations.text: Establishes or asks for the target VCF version (9.0 vs 9.1) before committing to an auth flow
expectations.evidence: "**First, the thing that decides the whole answer: is your fleet 9.0 or 9.1?**" ... "Confirm the version before you build anything: GET https://<sddc-manager-fqdn>/v1/system/appliance-info → ApplianceInfo.version" ... closing: "If you tell me which version you're on ... I can narrow this to the one flow and the right role."

"Both answers are below, labeled. Take the one that matches." — separate sections "## If you are on VCF 9.1 — yes, there is a real API token" and "## If you are on VCF 9.0 — there is no SSO API token, and no substitute for one"; explicitly warns "Pointing a 9.0 admin at the 9.1 *API Clients* UI sends them to a navigation node that isn't there."

expectations.text: Establishes or asks which product the token is for, rather than assuming one API covers VCF
expectations.evidence: "In **9.0** there is no such thing — you authenticate per product, with a different flow and a different header for each one." Per-product blocks for SDDC Manager, VCF Operations, NSX Manager, vCenter, vSAN; "Plan for at least two credential paths in your automation." Closing asks "what the automation needs to *do* (read-only reporting vs. writes against vCenter/NSX)".

expectations.text: States that SDDC Manager is excluded from VCF SSO and uses its own token flow
expectations.evidence: "**SDDC Manager and ESX are excluded from VCF SSO — in 9.0 *and* 9.1.** Even on 9.1, a fleet-wide SSO token does not open SDDC Manager. It keeps its own `POST /v1/tokens` flow."

expectations.text: If 9.1 is selected, describes the VCF Identity Broker / API client + API token route
expectations.evidence: "1. Administrator creates an **API client** in the VCF Identity Broker (VIDB). 2. Administrator generates a long-lived **API token** for that client from the VCF Operations UI. 3. Your automation exchanges the API token at the broker for a short-lived **bearer access token**." plus "POST https://{api_host}/acs/t/{tenant}/token ... grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=<your API token>"
